summary: Frontend-only test of 7 new date/time pickers (KNDateTimePicker ×3, KNTimePicker ×4) replacing legacy datetime-local/time inputs. All 7 pickers verified end-to-end: unified Indonesian labels ('Sab, 05 Sep 2026 · 14:30 WIB' / '08:30 WIB'), popover with kalender + Jam/Menit (step 5) columns + Selesai, correct testids, and successful save flow with backend integration. 0 console errors, 0 pageerrors, regression grep clean.
critical_code_review_comments: KNDateTimePicker/KNTimePicker components are clean, minimal, and reuse TimeColumns properly. No issues.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 CRM interaction (subject TEST_KNDT_1430) and patched shift shift_c91bc5f9ac08 jam_in=07:30 via UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_312 validated the new KNDateTimePicker (occurred_at/follow_up_date at CRM Interaksi, cfg-efffrom-{key} at Pusat Pengaturan) and KNTimePicker (setup-jam-in/out at HR Attendance Setup, manual-in/out at HR Attendance manual entry). Testable details: (a) cfg-efffrom-{key} only appears after: expand card → change value → click cfg-sched-toggle-{key}. (b) HR setup-jam-* only appears after clicking [data-testid^=setup-edit-shift_] or setup-create-button. (c) HR manual-in/out only appear after clicking 'Entry Manual' button. (d) Correct settings nav testid is 'nav-settings-hub' (not 'nav-settings'). (e) Regression grep of frontend/src for type="time"|type="datetime-local"|type="date"|type="month" returns only the allowed exceptions (KNDatePicker.jsx comment + DeliveryDetailModal.jsx <Field type="date"> which already uses KNDatePicker).
